name: CQUEST
author: Hélène RATINEY
command-line: unzip -j [ZIP_BASIS] -d basis && /run_cquest.sh [PARAM_FILE] [DATA_FILE] && python3 /plot_cquest_result.py -i . -o . -m basis && tar -czvf [OUT_FILE] [DATA_FILE] *quest_estim.mrui *quest_back.mrui *.txt && rm -rf basis

inputs.name: Parameter text file
inputs.description: File setting up constraints, options and prior knowledge used in cQuest algorithm

inputs.name: DATA file
inputs.description: File with .mrui extension containing the signal to quantify

inputs.name: Zipped data base folder
inputs.description: Archive containing metabolites & macromolecules in .mrui format

output-files.description: A tarball containing all result files
output-files.name: Output file
